name: Shamanic Vision
gameText: Echo 2 target card twice.
upright: What you have seen once, you will see again, louder. A vision returns to confirm what you feared was only a dream.
reversed: You chase an echo of a moment that will not repeat. The voice you hear is your own, thrown back from the dark.

name: Soul Part
gameText: Split target into 2.
upright: Something in your life will split in two, and both halves will live. Do not mourn the parting; there is more of you than you knew.
reversed: You are pulled in two directions at once, and neither half remembers what the whole wanted.

name: Reverse Flow
gameText: Apply enemy enchantment to the target card.
upright: The weapon raised against you can be taken and turned. Study what your enemy carries; it will soon be yours.
reversed: Beware wearing another's power. What you steal from the dark remembers its first master.

name: Moirai
gameText: Deal 4 Elemental damage of a random type(Fire, Electric, Water, Earth) to target.
upright: The Fates have drawn a thread for you, but they did not say which color. Force is coming; its form is left to chance.
reversed: You demand to know what cannot be known. The thread is cut whether you watch or not.

name: Fire Aura
gameText: Gain 3 Block, attackers get inflicted with fire element.
upright: Your defenses are not passive. Those who strike at you now will carry away the burn of it.
reversed: Your walls burn too hot. Those who reach for you in kindness are scorched along with the rest.

name: Inspect
gameText: Inflict target with an Investigation Counter.
upright: A small detail has caught your eye. Mark it; it is the first stair of a long descent into the truth.
reversed: Some doors are not meant to be studied. The longer you look, the more something looks back.

name: Deduct
gameText: Consume all Investigation Counters on target, For each counter consumed this way inflict target with Weakness 1.
upright: Scattered clues assemble into one terrible shape. Understanding comes, and with it the power to weaken what you understand.
reversed: You reach the answer too early, with too little, and the conclusion you build is a house over a void.

name: Clear Mind
gameText: Remove 1 Debuff Infliction from target.
upright: One affliction that has clung to you will fall away. For a moment the fog thins and you can see the shore.
reversed: You clear one shadow only to notice the others. Clarity can be its own burden.

name: Sap
gameText: Inflict target with Weakness 2.
upright: Your opponent's strength is ebbing, like a tide drawn by an unseen moon. Patience will finish what force cannot.
reversed: It is your own strength that seeps away. Rest before the tide takes all of it.

name: Gag
gameText: Inflict target with Silence 2.
upright: There are things you must not say yet. Hold your words; the silence is protecting you.
reversed: Something you need to speak has been swallowed. The unspoken grows heavier in the dark.

name: Concuss
gameText: Stun target.
upright: A sudden blow will halt everything. In the stillness after, you will see what was moving all along.
reversed: You are frozen by a shock that has already passed. The world moves on while you stand dazed.

name: Throwing Knife
gameText: Deal 1 Physical Damage to target, inflict Embedded Knife to target.
upright: A small act now lodges deep and waits. What seems minor today is the seed of a later reckoning.
reversed: A splinter of the past is still buried in you. Until it is drawn out, it will not heal.

name: Drive Deeper
gameText: Deal 3 Physical Damage to target, Consume 1 Embedded Knife from target. If you Consume Embedded Knife from target, deal 6 Physical Damage to target.
upright: Return to the wound you opened long ago. The second stroke lands with the weight of the first.
reversed: You press on an old injury out of habit. Some cuts need no deepening.

name: Rip Away
gameText: Deal 3 Physical Damage to target, Consume 1 Embedded Knife from target. If you Consume 'Embedded Knife' from target, deal 2 Bleed II Damage to target, ADD 1x 'Throwing Knife' to your Hand.
upright: What you tear free comes back to your hand. A painful ending arms you for the next beginning.
reversed: You rip out the thorn and reach at once for another. Ask why the cycle comforts you.

name: Meditate
gameText: Stabilize 2.
upright: In the howling, find a single still point. A small calm now keeps the abyss at the edge of sight.
reversed: You sit in silence, but the silence is not empty. Something is listening to your breath.

name: Cleanse
gameText: Stabilize 3, Dismiss.
upright: Steady yourself, then let it go entirely. What you release cannot follow you down the corridor.
reversed: You scrub at a stain that is not on the surface. Some marks are written beneath the skin.

name: Bury
gameText: Stabilize 4.
upright: You may purchase peace with a piece of yourself. Bury what haunts you; the ground will hold it, for now.
reversed: What is buried does not stay buried. The earth over your secret is already shifting.

name: Elucidate
gameText: Evade 1, Stabilize 4.
upright: A sudden understanding lets you step aside from a blow you never saw coming. Lucidity is its own armor.
reversed: You understand too much to be at ease. Some knowledge sharpens the mind until it cuts.

name: Reform
gameText: Stabilize 2, Glitchshift(Stabilize).
upright: You will become a slightly different version of yourself, and the new shape will hold better than the old.
reversed: You keep changing form to escape a fear that changes with you.

name: Serendipitous Remedy
gameText: Stabilize 1-6.
upright: Help is coming, though no one can say how much. Drink what fortune pours and do not complain of the measure.
reversed: You stake your recovery on chance. The cup may be full, or it may hold a single drop.

name: Backstep
gameText: Gain 3 Block, Gain 1 Combo Point.
upright: Stepping back is not defeat. Each careful retreat gathers strength for the strike to come.
reversed: You retreat so often you have forgotten you meant to return.

name: Needle Box
gameText: ADD 4x 'Needle' to your draw pile.
upright: No single blow will decide this. Prepare many small efforts; together they will draw blood.
reversed: You are buried under small tasks, each harmless, together suffocating.

name: Needle
gameText: Deal 1 Bleed I Damage to target.
upright: A tiny wound, precisely placed, bleeds longer than a grand one. Precision outlasts power.
reversed: A minor irritation is slowly draining you. Name it before it becomes a wound.

name: Borrowed Time
gameText: Heal 12, deal 6 Poison damage to self.
upright: Relief is offered now, and generously. Accept it, but know the bill is already on its way.
reversed: You have lived on borrowed hours for too long. The lender is growing impatient.

name: Calculated Sacrifice
gameText: Heal 6.
upright: Give a little of yourself and receive more in return. This sacrifice is a sound bargain.
reversed: You give and give, and call it strategy. Make sure the ledger truly balances.

name: Cruelty
gameText: Deal 6 Arcane Damage to target, if the target is at Low Health Heal 6.
upright: When your opponent falters, you will be tempted to press the advantage. Fortune favors the unflinching, but it remembers.
reversed: You feed on the weakness of others and call it strength. The hunger will turn inward.

name: Transmute Essence
gameText: Deal 6 Arcane Damage to target, Heal 6.
upright: What you take from the world becomes your own vitality. A trade of essences leaves you renewed.
reversed: The alchemy runs one way only. Watch what you become through what you consume.

name: Self Confidence
gameText: Gain 2 Block, if you have 'Toughness' infliction Gain 6 Block.
upright: Your defenses are only as strong as your belief in them. Trust what has already toughened you.
reversed: Doubt has thinned your armor. You are stronger than you currently believe.

name: Desperate Retreat
gameText: Deal 2 Physical Damage to yourself, target is inflicted with Feign 1.
upright: Sometimes you must bleed a little to make the hunter believe the chase is over.
reversed: You wound yourself to escape a danger that was never as near as you feared.

name: Lethargy
gameText: Do nothing, Dismiss.
upright: Not every hour demands action. Like the sleeper beneath the waves, you may wait, and the waiting is not wasted.
reversed: You call it patience, but it is paralysis. The world will not dream on your behalf.

name: Glitch
gameText: Dismiss.
upright: Something in the pattern of your days does not fit. That flaw is a door, if you dare to pass through it.
reversed: A small error is quietly unraveling the weave. Find it before the whole cloth comes apart.

name: Second Chance
gameText: Draw 1, Dismiss.
upright: A door you thought sealed will open once more. Step through quickly; it will not open a third time.
reversed: You wait for a second chance you have already been given.

name: Miss Input
gameText: Target Gains 2 Block, Delete.
upright: An error will help someone you never meant to help. Accept it with grace; not every mistake is a curse.
reversed: You strengthen the very thing you meant to fight. Check your aim.

name: Forced Mistake
gameText: Target gains Feign 1, Dismiss.
upright: Under pressure, the other side will stumble. Wait for the trembling hand.
reversed: Someone is pushing you toward a mistake. Slow down; the haste is not your own.

name: Fumble
gameText: Deal 1 Physical Damage to target, Delete.
upright: A clumsy effort still lands, faintly, and then is gone. Not every attempt needs grace to matter.
reversed: Your grip is slipping on something you care about. Hold it more deliberately.

name: Lynch
gameText: Deal 1 Physical Damage, Critical 4. Dismiss.
upright: A brutal judgment is coming, swift and heavy. It will land, but it will cost the one who delivers it.
reversed: You are being judged by a crowd that has already decided. Do not lend them your voice.

name: Relapse
gameText: Instantly fill MB to max when drawn.
upright: An old tide surges back without warning. What you thought you had outgrown returns to test you.
reversed: You fear the return of something long gone, and the fear itself is what calls it back.

name: Query Library
gameText: Glitchshift(Dungeon Deck).
upright: Seek, and the stacks will offer a volume you did not request. Read it carefully; some pages read you back.
reversed: You search endlessly for an answer you do not truly want to find.

name: Compelled Introspection
gameText: Glitchshift(Current Character).
upright: You will be made to look inward, whether you wish to or not. The face in the deep mirror is still yours.
reversed: You avoid your reflection, but it has been following you from room to room.

name: Left Hook
gameText: Deal 3 Physical Damage to target, Gain 1 Combo Point.
upright: Strike first and strike plainly. A simple opening builds toward a greater blow.
reversed: You keep opening and never finishing. Momentum unspent is momentum lost.

name: Sleight of Hand
gameText: Backpocket target card.
upright: Keep something hidden in reserve, even at a cost. The card you hold back will save you later.
reversed: You hide so much that even you have forgotten what is up your sleeve.

name: Not Yet
gameText: Target a card, send the target to the top of the draw pile.
upright: Not now, but soon. What you push away will return to the top of the pile when the time is right.
reversed: You keep saying “not yet” to something that has waited long enough.

name: Haymaker
gameText: Deal 3 Physical Damage to target.
upright: No tricks, no rituals. A direct and honest effort is all this moment requires.
reversed: Brute force will not solve a problem that has no surface to strike.

name: Take Cover
gameText: Gain 3 Block.
upright: Find cover and wait for the storm to pass. There is no shame in surviving.
reversed: You have hidden so long that the shelter has become a cage.

name: Fang
gameText: Apply 3 Poison Infliction to target.
upright: A small bite now will do its work long after. Plant your influence and let time carry it.
reversed: Something has already bitten you. The venom works quietly; look for the mark.

name: Sting
gameText: Apply 6-9 Poison Infliction to target.
upright: A powerful influence enters the bloodstream of events. Its full strength is uncertain, but it will be felt.
reversed: A sharp word or deed lingers far longer than you meant it to.

name: Toxicate
gameText: If the target is poisoned, apply 3 Poison Infliction to the target.
upright: Where weakness already exists, press further. Small advantages compound into ruin for your foe.
reversed: One bad habit feeds another. Break the chain at its first link.

name: Contaminate
gameText: Apply 3 Poison Infliction to target, If the target is bleeding instead Apply 6 Poison Infliction.
upright: An open wound in your rival's defenses invites deeper corruption. Strike where they already bleed.
reversed: Old wounds have left you open to new taint. Tend them before something seeps in.

name: Envenom
gameText: Apply 2 Poison Infliction to target, ALL damage the target deals is poison damage as long as they are poisoned.
upright: Taint the source and everything that flows from it changes. Your influence will color all they do.
reversed: Something has poisoned your well, and every word you speak now carries it.

name: Bloodseeker Vial
gameText: Apply 6 Poison Infliction to target, Coagulate 9.
upright: A potent concoction is brewing in your life. It will both poison and bind; be sure which side of the glass you stand on.
reversed: You mix forces you do not understand. The vial is warm in your hand for a reason.

name: Worship
gameText: Gain 3 Block, Luck 1.
upright: Bow to something greater and it will shelter you, a little. Faith offers both shield and fortune.
reversed: You kneel to something that does not know your name. Ask what your devotion truly buys.

name: Inspiration
gameText: Gain 1 AP.
upright: A sudden surge of energy and purpose, drawn from somewhere deep. Use it well; it was not freely given.
reversed: Inspiration that costs this much may not be your own. Who whispered it?

name: Flesh Offering
gameText: Luck 3.
upright: Give something of yourself to the unseen, and fortune will tilt your way.
reversed: Whatever grants your luck is keeping a careful tally.

name: Ritual Dagger
gameText: Deal 1-3 Physical Damage, Luck 1, Hungry 2, Dip.
upright: A ritual begins with a small cut. Its power grows with hunger, and luck walks beside the blade.
reversed: The ritual has become a compulsion. The dagger hungers, and so do you.

name: Cull
gameText: Deal 2-8 Physical Damage to target, if the target is at low health deal 8 Physical Damage instead.
upright: Cut away what is already failing. The weakest thing in your life is ready to be ended cleanly.
reversed: You prune too eagerly. Not all that struggles is meant to be cut down.

name: Right Hook
gameText: Spend all of your Combo Points, Deal 3 Physical Damage per CP spent this way.
upright: Everything you have built comes to bear at once. The preparation was the point; now spend it.
reversed: You spend everything in a single moment and are left with empty hands.

name: Stunner
gameText: Stun the target.
upright: Strike with such force that the world holds its breath. In that pause, the advantage is yours.
reversed: A shock has left you reeling. Wait for the ringing to fade before you decide anything.

name: Slash
gameText: Deal 2 Bleed I-II Damage to target.
upright: A swift, clean cut that keeps working long after the blade has passed.
reversed: A careless word has opened something that will not close quickly.

name: Gouge
gameText: Deal 2 Physical Damage to target, Rend.
upright: Tear open what was closed to you. Your rival's guard will not mend in time.
reversed: Someone has torn into your defenses. Patch the breach before you fight again.

name: Puncture
gameText: Deal 3 Bleed II Damage to target.
upright: A pointed truth will pierce deeper than any shout. Aim it carefully.
reversed: A sharp truth has found you. It hurts because it is accurate.

name: Salt the Wounds
gameText: Deal 2 Physical Damage to target, Haemophilia 5.
upright: Once the wound is open, deepen its misery. Your enemy will not heal while you are watching.
reversed: You keep reopening your own pain. Let the salt wash away.

name: Lifesteal
gameText: Deal 2 Physical Damage to target, Blood-Drinker 4-6.
upright: Draw strength from the struggle itself. Every blow you land returns to you as life.
reversed: Something drinks from you while you sleep. Notice who grows stronger as you grow pale.

name: Exsanguinate
gameText: Deal 2 Physical Damage to target, Coagulate 5.
upright: A slow draining will become a halting. What flows freely now will soon thicken and stop.
reversed: Your energy has gone stagnant. Stir the blood before it sets.

name: Blood Spear
gameText: Deal 2 Physical Damage to target, Blood-Curse 3.
upright: Pay in blood to lay a curse that will follow your foe for days.
reversed: A curse you laid long ago is circling back to its maker.

name: Target
gameText: Inflict target with Weakness 1, ADD 2x 'Haymaker' to your hand.
upright: Choose your mark and gather your strength. Focus turns many small efforts into one decisive purpose.
reversed: You have become someone else's target. Change your path.

name: Pound of Flesh
gameText: Deal 2 Bleed I-II Damage to target, ADD 2x 'Restore' to Draw Pile.
upright: What is taken now will be returned to you later. The wound is the down payment on recovery.
reversed: Someone demands their pound of flesh. Decide whether the debt is truly yours.

name: Deluge of Blood
gameText: Deal 2 Bleed I Damage to target area, Rend.
upright: A great flood will sweep across many parts of your life at once. You will pay to unleash it, but nothing will stand unchanged.
reversed: You are drowning in a crisis you helped summon.

name: Blood Lance
gameText: Deal 4 Bleed II Damage to target, Rend.
upright: Stake much of yourself on a single piercing effort. It will strike true, if you can bear the cost.
reversed: You are giving more of yourself than this cause deserves.

name: Injector
gameText: Enchant target cards damage type into Bleed I Damage.
upright: Something ordinary will be changed at its core. Infuse your intent into what you already have.
reversed: Something has been slipped into your routine and is changing you. Notice what you have been taking in.

name: Haematology 101
gameText: Deal 2 Bleed I Damage to target, Blood Curse 1, Quest(deal damage with Blood Curse 0/3).[Turns into Haematology 102]
upright: You are a student of something old and red. Learn the first lesson well; the curriculum grows darker.
reversed: You skip ahead before the basics are mastered. The blood does not forgive shortcuts.

name: Haematology 102
gameText: Deal 4 Bleed II Damage to target, Blood Curse 2, Quest(deal damage with Blood Curse 0/3).[Turns into Hemomancy 201]
upright: Your understanding deepens. The forbidden discipline begins to answer when you call.
reversed: Knowledge outpaces wisdom. You know how, but not yet whether you should.

name: Hemomancy 201
gameText: Deal 4 Bleed III Damage to target, Blood Curse 3.
upright: Your long study bears fruit. What began as a lesson is now true power, and it answers to you.
reversed: Mastery has made you forget the cost of each lesson. The blood remembers.

name: Ignite
gameText: Deal 2 Fire damage to target, Spread.
upright: A small flame catches. Your idea will spread further than you imagined.
reversed: A spark you dropped carelessly is spreading where you never intended.

name: Splash
gameText: Deal 2 Water damage to target, Cascade.
upright: One drop in still water sends rings to every shore. A small act will ripple outward.
reversed: Your feelings are spilling onto those around you. Mind the ripples.

name: Ember
gameText: Deal 4 Fire damage to target, Spread, Quest(play this card 0/6 times).[Turns into Fiery Lash]
upright: Tend the ember again and again. Repetition will turn a small fire into something fierce.
reversed: You keep feeding a flame that has outgrown its hearth.

name: Fiery Lash
gameText: Deal 6 Fire damage to target, Spread, inflict the target with Electric element instead of fire.
upright: Your fire has grown into something stranger: lightning born of flame. Expect power to arrive in an unexpected form.
reversed: Your power has changed into something you no longer recognize.
